title.en: Tale 17 — The Fur Coat in Summer

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: In the hot summer Juha wore a coat.
The coat was heavy and very warm.
People at the market asked him.

sentences.ar: הם אמרו: לא חם לך ככה?
sentences.en: They said: are you not hot like that?

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: אני יודע מה אני עושה.
sentences.en: Juha said: I know what I am doing.
He walked in the sun with the coat.
The sweat ran down his face.
He did not take it off at all.
In the evening he sat with his friends.
One asked again about the coat.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: בחורף אני קונה לחם.
sentences.en: He said: in the winter I buy bread.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ובקיץ אין לי כסף.
sentences.en: He said: and in the summer I have no money.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: המעיל הזה הוא הבית שלי.
sentences.en: He said: this coat is my house.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הוא שומר עליי מהשמש.
sentences.en: He said: it protects me from the sun.
He said: and in the winter from the rain and the cold.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: לעני אין שני בגדים.
sentences.en: He said: a poor man does not have two garments.
